title: CPMigrate Configuration
description: Configuration file for CPMigrate - Central Package Management migration tool

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for IDE autocomplete

conflictStrategy.description: How to handle version conflicts: Highest (use latest), Lowest (use earliest), or Fail (stop migration)

backup.description: Whether to create backups before modifying files

addGitignore.description: Whether to add backup directory to .gitignore

keepVersionAttributes.description: Whether to keep Version attributes in project files after migration

mergeExisting.description: Whether to merge into an existing Directory.Packages.props file

outputFormat.description: Output format: Terminal (rich UI), Json (for CI/CD), or Sarif (GitHub code scanning; requires --analyze)

baseline.description: Path to the accepted-findings baseline. Findings it records are reported but do not fail the build, so CI gates on new problems only. Generate with: cpmigrate --analyze --write-baseline

failOn.description: Lowest finding severity that fails the build during --analyze. Info fails on any finding; Never reports without gating. Does not suppress exit 8 for an incomplete scan.

enabled.description: Whether automatic backup retention is enabled

maxBackups.description: Maximum number of backups to keep

excludeDirectories.description: Directories to exclude when scanning for solutions in batch mode
